snippet.title: Carrier Cuties - Pets In Mechs! Prototype Pet Mech Intro Trailer
snippet.description:
In the future, AI extinguishes all of humanity. All that is left are our pets.  They build Hu-Mechs to control their most primitive instincts!

Carrier Cuties fast-paced 3D arena fighting game where Pets in Hu-Mechs battle in highly interactive and destructible environments using the surroundings to fight. Battle with a partner against two opponents to win all the glory and treats!

Battle over momentum shifting Power Cells.  Knockdown your opponent to eject their Power Cell and grab it for yourself.  Collect three and enter your Beast Mode unlocking powerful super attacks.
